author: Dr Ben Miles
description:
Psychedelics have fascinated us for centuries, but they've never made the leap into mainstream medicine. Now that might be changing. A new drug (BLP-003) derived from toad venom and developed by AtaiBeckley, has just been bought by pharmaceutrical giant Eli Lilly for $2.8 billion.

 So does this finally mean psychedelics are hitting the mainstream?

If you want the full deep dive into the history of psychedelics check out my previous video: https://youtu.be/47U6uxEUDr8

Are you a scientist that want to make a difference? Sign up to my secret project here: 
https://forms.gle/b6zW19Z5NzTjS8gy8

⚠️ A note on safety
This video covers the history and neuroscience of psychedelic medicine, including ongoing clinical research. It is not a recommendation to use these substances. Outside of a regulated clinical setting, psychedelics carry real risks - particularly for people with a personal or family history of psychosis or bipolar disorder. If you're struggling with mental health, please speak
title: This Psychedelic Therapy Just Cured Depression and Is Going Mainstream
